name: SOC 2 Type II Trust Services Criteria
description: SOC 2 Type II evaluates the design and operating effectiveness of controls relevant to security, availability, processing integrity, confidentiality, and privacy.

categories.name: Common Criteria (Security)
categories.description: Controls relevant to security across the organization

categories.name: Availability
categories.description: Controls ensuring the system is available for operation and use

categories.name: Processing Integrity
categories.description: Controls ensuring system processing is complete, valid, accurate, timely, and authorized

controls.title: COSO Environment - Commitment to Integrity
controls.description: The entity demonstrates a commitment to integrity and ethical values.

controls.title: COSO Environment - Board Independence
controls.description: The board of directors demonstrates independence from management and exercises oversight.

controls.title: COSO Environment - Structure and Authorities
controls.description: Management establishes structures, reporting lines, and appropriate authorities.

controls.title: COSO Environment - Commitment to Competence
controls.description: The entity demonstrates a commitment to attract, develop, and retain competent individuals.

controls.title: COSO Environment - Accountability
controls.description: The entity holds individuals accountable for their internal control responsibilities.

controls.title: COSO Information - Relevant Information
controls.description: The entity obtains or generates relevant, quality information.

controls.title: COSO Information - Internal Communication
controls.description: The entity internally communicates information necessary to support controls.

controls.title: COSO Information - External Communication
controls.description: The entity communicates with external parties about matters affecting controls.

controls.title: Risk Assessment - Objectives
controls.description: The entity specifies objectives with sufficient clarity.

controls.title: Risk Assessment - Risk Identification
controls.description: The entity identifies and assesses risks to the achievement of objectives.

controls.title: Risk Assessment - Fraud Risk
controls.description: The entity considers the potential for fraud in assessing risks.

controls.title: Risk Assessment - Change Management
controls.description: The entity identifies and assesses changes that could significantly impact controls.

controls.title: Monitoring - Ongoing Evaluations
controls.description: The entity selects, develops, and performs ongoing and/or separate evaluations.

controls.title: Monitoring - Deficiency Communication
controls.description: The entity evaluates and communicates internal control deficiencies.

controls.title: Control Activities - Selection
controls.description: The entity selects and develops control activities that mitigate risks.

controls.title: Control Activities - Technology Controls
controls.description: The entity selects and develops general control activities over technology.

controls.title: Control Activities - Policies
controls.description: The entity deploys control activities through policies and procedures.

controls.title: Logical Access - User Provisioning
controls.description: The entity implements logical access security software.

controls.title: Logical Access - Authentication
controls.description: Prior to issuing system credentials, the entity registers and authorizes users.

controls.title: Logical Access - Access Removal
controls.description: The entity authorizes, modifies, or removes access to data, software, and functions.

controls.title: Logical Access - Access Review
controls.description: The entity implements controls to prevent or detect unauthorized software.

controls.title: Logical Access - Data Transmission
controls.description: The entity restricts transmission of data to authorized users.

controls.title: Logical Access - Malware Prevention
controls.description: The entity implements controls to prevent or detect malicious software.

controls.title: System Operations - Detection
controls.description: The entity uses detection and monitoring procedures to identify changes.

controls.title: System Operations - Security Events
controls.description: The entity monitors system components and evaluates detected events.

controls.title: System Operations - Incident Response
controls.description: The entity evaluates security events to determine whether they are incidents.

controls.title: System Operations - Incident Containment
controls.description: The entity responds to identified security incidents.

controls.title: System Operations - Recovery
controls.description: The entity identifies, develops, and implements recovery activities.

controls.title: Change Management - Changes
controls.description: The entity authorizes, designs, develops, configures, tests, approves, and implements changes.

controls.title: Risk Mitigation - Risk Identification
controls.description: The entity identifies, selects, and develops risk mitigation activities for risks.

controls.title: Risk Mitigation - Vendor Risk
controls.description: The entity assesses and manages risks associated with vendors.

controls.title: Availability - Capacity Planning
controls.description: The entity maintains, monitors, and evaluates current processing capacity.

controls.title: Availability - Environmental Protection
controls.description: The entity authorizes, designs, develops, tests, and implements backup procedures.
